criteria.hook: first 2 seconds: is the problem clear and does it stop the scroll? (big title + spoken hook)
criteria.avatar: presenter looks like a real person talking: lips match the words, natural face, not a frozen photo
criteria.zoho_screens: the Zoho Books steps are SHOWN on screen, the exact button/field is highlighted, readable
criteria.pacing: visual change every 2-4 s, no dead time, length fits the content (25-60 s)
criteria.captions: readable, in sync, match the speech exactly, not covering important parts
criteria.audio: clear voice, natural English, music present but quiet under the voice
criteria.value: a Zoho Books user learns a real, correct fix they can follow
criteria.polish: looks as professional as the reference Shorts (layout, fonts, colours, no glitches)
